name: determly/chat-laravel
description: Mounts the Persona chat widget on any Laravel stack and streams the Persona SSE wire.

suggest.laravel/ai: Stream the Persona chat through Laravel AI 1.4. When Prism is also installed, set DETERMLY_CHAT_AI=laravel-ai.
suggest.prism-php/prism: Stream the Persona chat through Prism 0.103. When Laravel AI is also installed, set DETERMLY_CHAT_AI=prism. Prism also needs DETERMLY_CHAT_PROVIDER and DETERMLY_CHAT_MODEL.
